method: One common whole-figure uniform scale per character from frontal cranium ellipse area160x150. Per-view sole translation only. No silhouette auto-fit, mirrored frames, separate head/leg resizing or anisotropic warping. Native source component isolation avoids truncation by arbitrary row cuts.
measurementMethod: Sol visual estimates of the anatomical cranium and face under hair, reviewed on full-source four-view coordinate contact sheets. Ellipse=[cx,cy,w,h,roll] in source1254px. Back/covered skulls are inferred; hats, ears, hair, horns and props are excluded. Visible chin estimates plus inferred rear chin; foot proposals are from opaque pixels near the body axis and must be checked on the final ground-line lineup. Not detector or rig ground truth.
sourceNote: PNG and q95 WebP preserve the user-reviewed final pack. Generation originals/prompts and frozen old comparisons remain in the delivered local archive; generationSourceSha256 identifies that archive input, not a repository file.
